result.title: QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
result.summary: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 QORH，把查询相关的规则头与有序规则体联合编码为超边，用置信度、覆盖率等统计证据做可学习规则选择，并通过角色感知的超图消息传递增强关系表示，以支持归纳式知识图谱链路预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属较远领域（知识图谱链路预测），但「查询条件下有序规则体的组合编码 + 基于置信度/覆盖率的可学习规则筛选」可能为 LVR 中结构化推理状态表示、视觉证据筛选与监督贡献分配提供类比线索，是否可迁移需核查。
